description: This source file defines a PaymentServiceClient class that acts as an adapter to communicate with a payment service via HTTP calls. It provides a method to authorize PayPal payments by making a POST request and handles exceptions appropriately.

classes.name: PaymentServiceClient
classes.description: Client adapter for communicating with the payment service, specifically handling PayPal payment authorization.

classes.name: PaymentServiceClient.PaymentServiceClientException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception used for wrapping errors during communication with the payment service.

methods.name: authorizePayPal
methods.description: Sends a request to authorize a PayPal payment with the provided request data and Bearer token, returning an authorization response or throwing an exception on failure.
